distribution.title: A collection of texts of Orthodox hagiographies in Latvian allows us to delve deeper into the historical meaning of these texts and helps us understand the cultural environment and textual forms of a particular diaspora.

dataset.title: Orthodox hagiographies written in Latvian language

dmp.description:
The project is developed within the project No 5.2.1.1.i.0/2/24/I/CFLA/003
"Implementation of consolidation and management changes at Riga Technical University,
Liepaja University, Rezekne Academy of Technology, Latvian Maritime Academy and
Liepaja Maritime College for the progress towards excellence in higher education, science
and innovation" funded by the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility
The aim of this research is to:
-study how hagiographies and other Latvian Orthodox spiritual literature were historically formed,
-to what canons is it subjected and
-what is their function in Latvian culture.
dmp.title: Elements of mysticism in the genre of Orthodox hagiography in Latvian literature - Academic career PhD (doctoral) grant (ID 1121)
